# whatwhatboy.com

> whatwhatboy.com is a download directory for PC and console mod menus, game mods, and scripts. It also lists game downloads, console homebrew, emulators, setup guides, and modding tools.

The individual listings are the source for download links and compatibility details. Check the listing for the supported platform, game update, region, title ID, firmware, or loader where applicable. Availability and requirements vary by build.

Some files are hosted by whatwhatboy.com. Other listings link to publisher releases or third-party download pages. Use the canonical listing URL when citing a resource so readers can find its current links and version notes.

## Main sections

- [Homepage](https://whatwhatboy.com/)
- [PC and console mod menus](https://whatwhatboy.com/pages/mods-selector.html)
- [Console mods by platform](https://whatwhatboy.com/console/mods/)
- [PS4 mod menu downloads and PS5 game tools](https://whatwhatboy.com/console/mods/ps4/menus.html)
- [Console setup and homebrew guides](https://whatwhatboy.com/console/)
- [Game downloads](https://whatwhatboy.com/games-downloads/)
- [Emulators for PC](https://whatwhatboy.com/pc/emulators.html)
- [Modding tools](https://whatwhatboy.com/tools/)
- [Source code listings](https://whatwhatboy.com/source-codes/)
- [Public page sitemap](https://whatwhatboy.com/sitemap.xml)
